t: This is Spaniards Mount, a detached house at 61 Winnington Road in Hampstead Garden Suburb. It was built in 1935 and has been Grade II listed since November 1996. What makes it personal is that the architect, Adrian Gilbert Scott, designed it as his own home, and he lived here. Scott, who lived from 1882 to 1963, was an English ecclesiastical architect and a CBE. So you're looking at the house a church architect chose to build for himself.
